responses: I made my first unreleased on the 18th of July, one day after making my server!
I still don’t have my own pc😢
I don’t have a set up, only a wooden stand and my bed...
I use two phones, one for normal shit, and the other for unreleased.
I have burned custom CDs before..
I got the idea of making a server after meeting someone on TikTok live
I only use real sources for my unreleased
I have a biggg crush on blib /j
